figures.finding: Pakistan's federal government set up a Rs 2 billion Film Finance Fund in 2023, run with a Film Finance Committee, to support filmmakers for one year; its share of a budget, cap and selection rate were not found.

value.fund: Film (and Drama) Finance Fund, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting

figures.applies: Pakistan, filmmakers, from August 2023; whether it still operates on 2026-11-01 was not confirmed.

sources.said: According to the revised policy, cinemas are now granted exemption from income tax for five years, while import duties on cinema apparatus, and sales tax has been scrapped. The minister also revealed that the current government has established a Rs2bn Film Finance Fund to support filmmakers for one year, along with the creation of a Film Finance Committee.

figures.finding: No production rebate was found; the 2023 revision of the film policy instead gave cinemas a five-year income-tax exemption and scrapped import duties and sales tax on cinema equipment.
